GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly Pushed fwd & worked to lead on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside midrace & held together Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Joined @ 300m & pressured @ 250m. Outgunned in last 200m. # Led & weakened.
Jumped Well , Went Forward 3 Wide Kept Coming to Lead x 1.5 Lengths @ 700m. Joined on Straightening Up , Kept Trying past 200m, gave some ground late # run ended 200m
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got up fence turn 4 lengths. battled away # Never Likely
Jumped Ok pressed on to lead half clear, ridden along turn, headed Straightening Up , half off passing 200m b4 run ended 100m and gave ground to the line # led/weak L100
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rdr reported his mnt did not appreciate being pressured in the lead by another rnr and races better when able to dictate on its own terms and in his  opinion, this was detrimental to the geldings’ finishing efforts. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

jumped out fine. posted Four Wide early , came back 6th With Cover 5 Lengths @ 750m. Ridden Along Straightening Up . Clear enough Straight , Held Ground # 3w/just even

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was a little slow to begin.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened # Every Chance
Slow Out 1/2 length went through to settle outside leader. 2nd turn. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider stated that after being slow to begin he was obliged to make some use of his mount to go forward, however his mount did not travel well at any stage of the race and proved disappointing in the straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
